purpose: Preparation.md component A: estimate of the most suitable region wheat will shift to under climate change. The relation between wheat presence (USDA CDL) and the model reference climate (NASA NEX-GDDP 2015–2024) is learned in grid cells and the same model is applied to the 2040–2049 climate.
notes: The default box is the Kansas–Nebraska–Dakotas line (US Great Plains wheat belt). 1° cells: 7 × 13 = 91 cells, 3×3 per cell = 819 CDL points; 4 NASA requests per cell for climate (≈364 requests). The first download can take long; the cache is used on later runs. CDL covers only the contiguous US.
